raw.instruction: How can I create a formula in Excel that will sum values when the Department in column A equals 'PI' and the RU in column B equals 'Melbourne'? I've tried using a combination of 'PI&Melbourne' and excluding text with '<>*Med', but neither approach seems to work. I believe it could be either a = PI & Melbourne or "<>*Med"
